fullPassage:
Let's Celebrate Marine Gardening Day!

A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are ①<u>formed</u> by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with ②<u>them</u>. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading ③<u>contributors</u> to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have ④<u>threatening</u> marine plants.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ threatening → threatened. 'have threatened'에서 현재완료(have + p.p.). threatening(현재분사)은 완료형에 올 수 없음.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ④ threatening: have + p.p.(현재완료). have threatened(O), have threatening(X)
❌ ① formed: 수동태 are formed. 올바름
❌ ② them: marine plants를 가리키는 대명사. 올바름
❌ ③ contributors: the leading contributors. 명사. 올바름
det.tip: 현재완료: have/has + 과거분사(p.p.). threaten → threatened(과거분사). threatening은 현재분사/-ing형.

questions.passage: So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is ①<u>meant</u> to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of ②<u>creating</u> sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to ③<u>protect</u> and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on ④<u>this</u> day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ protect → protecting. 'contribute to protecting and reinforcing'에서 전치사 to 뒤에 동명사(-ing) 필요. protecting과 reinforcing 병렬.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ③ protect: contribute to + -ing. 전치사 to이므로 동명사 필요. protecting(O)
❌ ① meant: is meant to = ~하기 위한 것이다. 올바름
❌ ② creating: the importance of + 동명사. 올바름
❌ ④ this: this day = 이 날. 올바름
det.tip: contribute to + -ing(동명사). 이 to는 전치사. contribute to protecting(O), contribute to protect(X).

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact ①<u>that</u> there are forests in the sea. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to ②<u>creating</u> a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions have threatened marine plants and the other creatures ③<u>who</u> live on them. It is important ④<u>to realize</u> that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ who → that. 선행사가 'creatures'(동물/생물)이므로 who(사람)가 아닌 that이 적절. 사물/동물에는 that 또는 which 사용.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ③ who: 선행사 creatures(생물)는 사람이 아님. that/which가 적절
❌ ① that: 동격의 that. the fact that ~. 올바름
❌ ② creating: 전치사 to + 동명사. 올바름
❌ ④ to realize: It is important to ~. 가주어-진주어. 올바름
det.tip: 관계대명사 who = 사람, which/that = 사물/동물. creatures는 동물이므로 that 사용.

questions.passage: Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by ①<u>planting</u> marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people ②<u>picks</u> up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that ③<u>small</u> environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to ④<u>preserve</u> the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② picks → pick. 주어 'groups of people'(복수)이므로 동사는 pick(복수형).
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ② picks: 주어 groups(복수) → pick(복수 동사). picks는 단수 동사
❌ ① planting: by + 동명사. 올바름
❌ ③ small: 형용사로 명사 수식. 올바름
❌ ④ preserve: to + 동사원형(부정사). 올바름
det.tip: 주어-동사 수일치: groups of people(복수) → pick(O), picks(X). of 뒤가 아닌 groups가 주어.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures. However, ①<u>uncontrolled</u> human actions and climate change have ②<u>threatened</u> marine plants. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day." Accordingly, many organizations contribute to ③<u>damaging</u> and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. It is important to realize that small environmental activities can cause a big wave to ④<u>preserve</u> the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ damaging(손상시키다) → protecting(보호하다). 원문: 생태계를 보호하고 강화하는 데 기여. damaging은 반대 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ③ damaging: 원문은 protecting. 보호가 아닌 손상은 맥락에 맞지 않음
❌ ① uncontrolled(통제되지 않은): 원문 그대로
❌ ② threatened(위협했다): 원문 그대로
❌ ④ preserve(보존하다): 원문 그대로
det.tip: protecting(보호하다) ↔ damaging(손상시키다). 단체들은 보호를 위해 노력.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and ①<u>numerous</u> marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading ②<u>contributors</u> to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day." It is meant to raise ③<u>awareness</u> of the seriousness of ocean pollution. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to ④<u>exploit</u> the sea.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ exploit(착취하다) → preserve(보존하다). 원문: 바다를 보존하기 위한 큰 파도. exploit(착취)은 환경 보호 맥락에 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ④ exploit: 원문은 preserve(보존). 착취는 보호 맥락과 반대
❌ ① numerous(수많은): 원문 그대로
❌ ② contributors(기여자): 원문 그대로
❌ ③ awareness(인식): 원문 그대로
det.tip: preserve(보존하다) ↔ exploit(착취하다/이용하다). 글의 핵심: 바다를 보존하자.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"바다에는 숲이 존재하며, 해양 식물에 의해 형성된다."

det.korean: 원문: 'the sea has forests, too' + 'Sea forests are formed by marine plants.' 바다에 숲이 있고, 해양 식물이 형성. T.
det.analysis:
✅ T: 바다에 숲 있음 + 해양 식물에 의해 형성. 원문 일치
❌ F: 원문과 일치하므로 부적절
det.tip: formed by = ~에 의해 형성된. 수동태 표현.

questions.passage: However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"바다식목일은 여러 나라에서 이미 시행하고 있던 제도이다."

det.korean: 원문: 'the first in the world' — 세계 최초. 여러 나라에서 이미 시행이 아님. F.
det.analysis:
✅ F: 원문은 세계 최초(the first in the world). 이미 시행하던 제도가 아님
❌ T: 원문과 불일치
det.tip: the first in the world = 세계 최초. 한국이 최초로 지정.

questions.passage: Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"바다식목일에 사람들은 해안가에서 쓰레기를 줍는 활동을 한다."

det.korean: 원문: 'groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day.' 일치. T.
det.analysis:
✅ T: 해안가(coast)에서 쓰레기(trash) 줍기(pick up). 원문 일치
❌ F: 원문과 일치하므로 부적절
det.tip: pick up trash = 쓰레기를 줍다. along the coast = 해안을 따라.

questions.passage: That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world.
questions.stem: 한국 정부가 '바다식목일'을 제정한 직접적 이유로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 인간 활동과 기후변화로 해양 생태계가 위협받고 있어서

det.korean: 원문: 'uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants' → 그래서(So) 바다식목일을 지정.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 인간 활동+기후변화 위협: So 앞의 원인이 직접적 이유
❌ ① 관광객 유치: 언급 없음
❌ ③ 어업 기술: 언급 없음
❌ ④ 해양 스포츠: 언급 없음
det.tip: However(역접) + So(인과): 위협 → 그래서 바다식목일 제정.

questions.passage: It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day. It is important to realize that small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 'a big wave'가 비유적으로 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 작은 실천들이 모여 만드는 큰 변화

det.korean: 'small environmental activities' → 'a big wave to preserve the sea.' 작은 활동들이 모여 큰 변화를 일으킨다는 비유.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 작은 실천→큰 변화: small activities → big wave. 비유적 의미
❌ ② 자연재해: 물리적 파도가 아닌 비유
❌ ③ 대규모 예산: 원문은 smaller scale 강조
❌ ④ 국제 규제: 언급 없음
det.tip: a big wave = 큰 변화(비유). small → big 대비가 핵심 메시지.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea, but the sea has forests, too. Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 대부분의 사람들이 바다 숲의 존재를 잘 알고 있다
해저 숲에는 해양 동물이 거의 살지 않는다
해저 숲은 건강한 해양 생태계를 만드는 데 주요 기여자이다
인간 활동은 해양 식물에 아무런 영향을 미치지 않는다

det.korean: 원문: 'the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem.' 일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 주요 기여자: leading contributors 일치
❌ ① 잘 알고 있다: unfamiliar(익숙하지 않은)과 반대
❌ ② 거의 살지 않는다: numerous(수많은)과 반대
❌ ④ 영향 없다: threatened(위협했다)와 반대
det.tip: leading contributors = 주요 기여자. 해저 숲의 역할 강조.

questions.passage: So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world. It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash along the coast on this day.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 바다식목일은 해양 오염의 심각성 인식을 높이기 위한 것이다
많은 단체가 해양 식물을 심어 생태계를 강화한다

det.korean: 원문: 'On a smaller scale, groups of people pick up trash.' 대규모만이 아닌 소규모 활동도 있음.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ④ 대규모만: 원문은 smaller scale(소규모) 활동도 포함. '~만'은 원문과 불일치
❌ ① 세계 최초: the first in the world 일치
❌ ② 인식 높이기: raise awareness 일치
❌ ③ 식물 심기: planting marine plants 일치
det.tip: on a smaller scale = 더 작은 규모에서. 대규모+소규모 모두 포함.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea. Sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. The Korean government designated May 10th as Marine Gardening Day. Many organizations and individuals participate in marine protection activities.
questions.stem: 다음 중 위 글의 내용에 비추어 틀린 문장은?
ch: Sea forests serve as living spaces for underwater animals.
Human activities and climate change have had no negative impact on marine plants.
The Korean government created Marine Gardening Day to promote ocean awareness.
People participate in activities like picking up coastal trash on Marine Gardening Day.

det.korean: ② 원문은 'uncontrolled human actions have threatened marine plants.' 부정적 영향이 있음. 'no negative impact'은 틀림.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ② no negative impact: 원문은 threatened(위협). 부정적 영향 있음
❌ ① living spaces: habitats 일치
❌ ③ promote awareness: raise awareness 일치
❌ ④ picking up trash: pick up trash 일치
det.tip: threatened = 위협했다. negative impact 있음. 원문과 반대.

questions.passage: However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants and the other creatures that live on them. So the Korean government designated May 10th every year as "Marine Gardening Day," the first in the world.
questions.stem:
위 글에서 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 찾아 쓰시오.

"한국 정부는 매년 5월 10일을 '바다식목일'로 __________했다."

(**영어** 단어를 쓰시오)

det.korean: 원문: 'the Korean government designated May 10th' — 지정했다.
det.analysis: ✅ designated: 원문에서 직접 찾기. 정부가 공식적으로 지정.
det.tip: designate(지정하다). designated = 지정했다. designate A as B = A를 B로 지정하다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

"작은 환경 활동이 바다를 보존하는 큰 파도를 일으킬 수 있다."

→ Small environmental activities can cause a big __________ to preserve the sea.

(한 **영어** 단어를 쓰시오)

det.korean: 원문: 'can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.' — 큰 파도(변화).
det.analysis: ✅ wave: 원문 그대로. a big wave = 큰 파도(비유: 큰 변화).
det.tip: wave: 파도, 물결. 비유적으로 큰 변화/흐름. cause a big wave = 큰 변화를 일으키다.

questions.passage: Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants. On a smaller scale, __________.
questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어들을 올바른 순서로 배열하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.

[pick / of / trash / groups / up / the / along / coast / people]

(모든 단어를 사용할 것, 대소문자 구분 없음, 마침표 생략 가능)

accept: groups of people pick up trash along the coast
Groups of people pick up trash along the coast

Groups of people pick up trash along the coast.

det.analysis: ✅ groups of people pick up trash along the coast: 원문 그대로.
det.tip: groups of people = 사람들의 무리. pick up trash = 쓰레기를 줍다. along the coast = 해안을 따라.

questions.passage: A lot of people may be unfamiliar with the fact that there are forests in the sea. Sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem. However, uncontrolled human actions and climate change have threatened marine plants. So the Korean government designated May 10th as "Marine Gardening Day." It is meant to raise awareness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Small environmental activities we do can cause a big wave to preserve the sea.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 해저 숲의 중요성과 바다식목일을 통한 해양 보전 노력
해양 생물의 다양한 종류와 분류 체계

det.korean: 글 전체: 해저 숲의 역할 → 위협 → 바다식목일 제정 → 보전 활동의 중요성.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 해저 숲+바다식목일+보전: 글의 전체 흐름 요약
❌ ② 육상 생태계: 해양 생태계가 주제
❌ ③ 해양 산업: 언급 없음
❌ ④ 생물 분류: 언급 없음
det.tip: 주제: sea forests + Marine Gardening Day + preserve the sea.

questions.passage: Sea forests are formed by marine plants, and numerous marine animals live there with them. That is, sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures and the leading contributors to creating a healthy marine ecosystem.

다음 한국어 문장을 주어진 조건에 맞게 영어로 완성하시오.

"해저 숲은 수중 생물의 서식지이다."

→ Sea forests are __________ for underwater creatures.

(한 단어를 쓰시오)

det.korean: 원문: 'sea forests are habitats for underwater creatures.' — 서식지.
det.analysis: ✅ habitats: 원문 그대로. 복수형 사용(여러 서식지).
det.tip: habitat(서식지). 복수형: habitats. be habitats for = ~의 서식지이다.

questions.passage: It is meant to raise awareness of the seriousness of ocean pollution and the importance of creating sea forests. Accordingly, many organizations contribute to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem in damaged ocean areas by planting marine plants.
questions.stem:
다음 한국어 문장을 주어진 조건에 맞게 영어로 완성하시오.

"많은 단체가 손상된 해양 지역의 생태계를 보호하고 강화하는 데 기여한다."

→ Many organizations __________ to protecting and reinforcing the ecosystem.

(한 단어를 쓰시오)

det.korean: 원문: 'many organizations contribute to protecting' — 기여한다.
det.analysis: ✅ contribute: 원문 그대로. contribute to + -ing = ~하는 데 기여하다.
det.tip: contribute(기여하다). contribute to = ~에 기여하다. 이 to는 전치사.
